Variant.title: Variant
Variant.description: Durian cultivar reference data defining variety characteristics and ripening schedules

description.description: Flesh texture, flavor profile, and eating quality

origin.description: Geographical origin or region of cultivar

characteristics.description: Botanical traits, canopy architecture, and disease tolerance

ripeningDays.description: Typical ripening cycle in days from anthesis/bloom

Tree.title: Tree
Tree.description: Individual durian tree asset with location, health status, and growth metrics

variant.description: Cultivar code reference corresponding to variants/{code}

block.description: Farm block designation (e.g. Block A, Block B)

condition.description: Current physiological and health condition rating

conditionNotes.description: Observations on symptoms, pest presence, or leaf color

floweringBranches.description: Count of scaffold branches currently bearing flowers

floweringClusters.description: Total count of flower clusters on the tree

estimatedFruitCount.description: Estimated count of developing durian fruits on tree

lastReportAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent field worker report

Report.title: Report
Report.description: Field worker inspection report with attached photos and condition change tracking

block.description: Farm block location at inspection time

workerPhone.description: Contact number of worker who completed inspection

photos.description: List of inspection photo URLs and thumbnails

conditionBefore.description: Condition of tree prior to inspection

conditionChanged.description: Whether this inspection changed the tree health classification

/trees/{treeId}.description: Orchard inventory of individual durian trees

/reports/{reportId}.description: Read-only historical field worker inspection logs
